notes.title: Welcome Home Native Linux Build and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Welcome Home Game Update:
Bug Fixes:

Fixed issue where players were getting stuck in walls in certain levels.
Resolved the audio glitch causing distorted sounds during cutscenes.
Fixed the lighting inconsistency in the third level that affected visibility.
Resolved the save game error that was causing progress loss for some players.
New Features:

Added a new hidden level accessible through a secret passage in the main hub level select area.
Enhanced the AI behavior for Enemy's to provide more realistic interactions. for the two areas.

Linux Build:
We are excited to announce the release of the new Linux build for "Welcome Home"! Linux users can now enjoy the game on their preferred platform.
The Linux build includes all the latest bug fixes and features available in the game, ensuring a smooth and immersive gaming experience for Linux players.
Experience the updated version of "Welcome Home" with improved gameplay, exciting new features, and support for Linux users. Get ready to dive back into the mysterious world of the game and uncover its secrets like never before!
